name: backlog-tracker-rules-tests
description: Tests for backlog-tracker's access-control layer: Firestore security rules (real rules file, Firebase emulator), the MCP server's logic (stubbed Firebase SDKs), and the MCP server over real HTTP driven by the official MCP client SDK.

scripts.test: npm run test:mcp && npm run test:client && npm run test:rules

//: The firebase client version here is independent of the 10.13.2 SDK the app loads from gstatic: this one only drives the emulator, and the rules under test are evaluated server-side. It tracks whatever @firebase/rules-unit-testing peers against.
